title: Program Terms, Section 8 — Closing the Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Account
content:
**8.1** Only the customer can close the **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** rewards account, and only when no paid tier is active: a paid tier is cancelled first.

**8.2** Where the tier forfeits points on closure, the points balance and every unused certificate are forfeited on the closing date.

**8.3** Closure cannot be undone, and a later enrollment starts from zero.

**Notes to the clauses**

| Question | Answer under the clauses |
|---|---|
| Can a care agent close the account for the customer? | No — only the customer can close it. |
| The customer holds an active Tailwise Plus Annual term and wants to close. | Not while the paid tier is active; the paid tier is cancelled first. |
| What happens to 2,400 points and two unused certificates on the closing date (hypothetical)? | On a tier that forfeits on closure — every tier does — all of them are forfeited. |
| The customer re-enrolls a month later. | The new enrollment starts from zero; the closure is not undone. |
